Condition.description: A condition on a run: the run's value at `path` is one of the listed values, written as an object with the string `path` and the non-empty list `any_of`.

any_of.description: The values the field may hold, at least one.

items.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.
items.description: Any JSON value except null at the top, with finite numbers.

path.description: The dotted path of the run field the condition reads.

EvaluatorRef.description: The evaluator a suite entry asks for: a name and the range of versions that may grade it, written as an object with the string `name` and the `SemVer` requirement `range`.

range.$comment: The text is a SemVer requirement; the Rust reader enforces the grammar.
range.description: The versions that may grade the entry, a `SemVer` requirement such as `^0.4`.

ExpectationId.description: An expectation identifier: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`.

FieldPath.description: A dotted path to a field: one or more segments joined by `.`, each a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or `_`.

Name.description: A plain name, such as that of a harness, a reader, a plug-in or a treatment: non-empty, with neither `@` nor white space.

Role.description: The part an expectation plays in grading, copied from its suite entry when it was graded.

oneOf.description: A requirement the run must meet.
A measure of how well the run did.
A measurement reported without a verdict on the run.

SuiteEntry.description: One expectation of a suite, written as an object: what to check (`kind` and `params`), who checks it (`evaluator`), how it counts (`role`), what it waits for (`depends_on`) and when it applies (`applies_to`).

applies_to.description: The conditions that must all hold for the expectation to apply to a run; absent when it applies to every run, otherwise at least one.

deadline_ms.$comment: Fits in 64 bits; a reader that holds numbers as doubles is exact only below 2^53.
deadline_ms.description: The time the evaluator may spend on the expectation, in milliseconds; absent when the evaluator's default for the kind applies.

depends_on.description: The ids of the expectations that must not fail or be blocked for this one to be graded.

evaluator.description: The evaluator that grades the expectation.

group.description: The group the expectation belongs to.

id.description: The expectation's identifier, unique in the suite.

kind.description: The kind of check, one of the kinds the evaluator describes.

params.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.
params.description: The parameters of the check, read by the evaluator and never expanded as templates.

role.description: The part the expectation plays in grading.

description: The expectations a run is graded against: a suite with the version marker `suite/1` in `schema` and the list `expectations`, whose ids are unique, whose dependencies name entries of the list and whose dependency graph has no cycle.

expectations.$comment: Unique ids, dependencies that name entries and the absence of a dependency cycle are enforced in Rust; JSON Schema cannot state them.
expectations.description: The expectations, in the order written.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `suite/1`.

source.description: Where a translated suite came from: any table. Candler stores it and never reads it.
